ideas.idea: AI Sandbox-as-a-Service: disposable VPS instances integrated with agentic coding tools (Cursor, Amp, Aider) where AI agents can safely execute dangerous commands (npm install, rm, shell scripts) in isolated environments with auto-snapshot and rollback on errors

Context-Debt Auditor CLI: a tool that analyzes project specification files (PRD, rules.md, constitution.md) and detects redundant, conflicting, or token-wasteful sections, then recommends pruning strategies to keep AI agent context windows efficient
